_build_xnat_page() → qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget¶

Build the XNAT-source page: project picker, config path, download folder/temp-cache toggle, and raw-scan reader format selector.

_build_xnat_scan_filter_group() → qtpy.QtWidgets.QGroupBox¶

Build the collapsible group of scan-type checkboxes used to filter the XNAT subject list.

_build_local_page() → qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget¶

Build the local-source page: pipeline preset, cohort/batch, DICOM/NIfTI/results root fields, and asset-type include checkboxes.

_path_row(edit: qtpy.QtWidgets.QLineEdit) → qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget¶

Wrap edit with a “…” browse button that fills it from a directory picker.

_browse_into(edit: qtpy.QtWidgets.QLineEdit) → None¶

Open a directory picker and set edit’s text to the chosen path.

cleanup_temp_dirs() → None¶

Delete every temporary XNAT download directory recorded in app state.

_is_xnat() → bool¶

True if the currently selected data source is XNAT (vs. a local pipeline preset).

_on_source_changed() → None¶

Switch the stacked page and re-label the action button/lists for the newly selected source, then reload its catalog/preset data.

_on_preset_changed() → None¶

Load the newly selected pipeline preset’s default roots into the local-page fields and refresh the subject list.

_set_batch_combo_text(batch: str) → None¶

Select batch in the cohort combo if it’s a listed item, else set it as free-text.

_refresh_cohort_combo(pesa_fat_layout: bool) → None¶

Populate cohort dropdown from NIfTI/DICOM/RESULTS roots (PESA-Fat).

_apply_local_roots() → None¶

Resolve the local DICOM/NIfTI/results roots and current batch from the form fields, then rescan and repopulate the subject list.

_local_subjects_status_text(preset_id: str) → str¶

Build the status label summarizing subject count and which asset sources are included for the current local preset.

_on_local_resource_filter_changed() → None¶

Rescan and refilter the subject list when the DICOM/NIfTI/results include checkboxes change, and refresh the resource list for the currently selected subject.

_browse_config() → None¶

Open a file picker for the XNAT config file and set the config-path field.

_browse_download_folder() → None¶

Open a directory picker for the persistent download folder and disable temp-only mode.

_on_temp_only_toggled(checked: bool) → None¶

Enable/disable (and clear) the persistent download-path field based on the temp-only toggle.

_current_project_id() → str¶

Currently selected XNAT project id.

_reload_xnat_catalog() → None¶

Reload the subject list and per-subject asset-slot map from the dataset catalog for the currently selected XNAT project, and rebuild the scan-filter checkboxes.

_rebuild_xnat_scan_filter_checkboxes(project_id: str, slots: list[str]) → None¶

Rebuild the scan-filter checkbox grid from slots, ordering the project’s default sequences and pipeline resources first.

_selected_xnat_scan_slots() → set[str]¶

Asset slots whose filter checkbox is currently checked.

_clear_xnat_scan_filters() → None¶

Uncheck every scan-filter checkbox and refresh the subject list.

_xnat_subjects_matching_scan_filter() → list[str]¶

All subjects, or (if any scan-filter checkboxes are checked) only subjects whose indexed assets satisfy the selected slots (all or any, per the match-all toggle).

_filter_subjects() → None¶

Rebuild the subject list widget applying the scan filter (XNAT) and search text.

_on_subject_selected(current: qtpy.QtWidgets.QListWidgetItem | None, _previous: qtpy.QtWidgets.QListWidgetItem | None) → None¶

Repopulate the resource list for the newly selected subject.

_populate_xnat_resources(subject_uid: str) → None¶

List subject_uid’s indexed raw scans and pipeline (eicab/qvtpy/4dflows) resources as checkable resource-list items.

_populate_local_resources(subject: str) → None¶

List subject’s local assets, requiring the pipeline roots to already be applied.

_refresh_resources() → None¶

Re-list local assets for the currently selected subject.

_refresh_resources_for_subject(subject: str) → None¶

List subject’s local DICOM/NIfTI/results assets (per the include checkboxes) as checkable resource-list items.

_selected_xnat_rows() → list[dict[str, Any]]¶

Payload dicts for every checked item in the resource list (XNAT mode).

_selected_local_assets() → list[nvitk.gui.pipeline.data_presets.LocalAsset]¶

LocalAsset entries for every checked item in the resource list (local mode).

_on_action() → None¶

Dispatch the action button to the XNAT download or local load handler based on the current source.

_scan_reader_is_dicom() → bool¶

True if the raw-scan reader format is currently set to DICOM (vs. NIfTI).

_uncheck_selected_resources() → None¶

Clear checkboxes for series/assets just retrieved.

_on_local_load() → None¶

Open every checked local asset into Napari and record the opened paths.

_on_xnat_download() → None¶

Validate the XNAT config/selection, prompt for the password, and start an _XnatDownloadWorker to fetch the checked resources in the background (to a temp cache or the configured download folder).

_on_progress(message: str) → None¶

Show a background-worker progress message in the status label and log panel.

_record_opened(paths: list[str]) → None¶

Notify the on_inputs_opened callback (if given) or append paths to the app’s input registry directly.

_on_download_ok(payloads: list) → None¶

Open every downloaded resource into Napari (expanding NIfTI directories to their files) and record the opened paths.

_on_download_failed(message: str) → None¶

Show the background worker’s failure message in the status label and as a notification.

_on_worker_finished() → None¶

Re-enable the action button and drop the finished worker reference.
